FAST

Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after he had two extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy , the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday (Nov 11), citing people familiar with the matter. The board is preparing to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine his future, the report added. Earlier in the day, the New York Times reported that Huang had an extramarital affair with a company executive who reported to him. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The reports come days after Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife , as Nvidia's board investigates whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. Nvidia's shares were down about 8 per cent in after-hours trading.

item.content:encoded:
米エヌビディア、フアンＣＥＯの解任を準備＝ＷＳＪ 7:41 配信

ジェンスン・フアン氏。10月19日、ベルリンで撮影。REUTERS/Lisi Niesner（ロイター） [１１日　ロイター] - 米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は１１日、関係者の話として、米エヌビディアの取締役会がジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の解任に向けて準備を進めていると報じた。同氏が中国のスパイと疑われる人物を含む２人と不倫関係を持ったことを受けたもの。

ＷＳＪによると、取締役会は早ければ１１日に会合を開き、同氏の進退を判断する準備を進めている。

item.title: ＯＰＥＣプラス、10月大幅増産 サウジがけん引 開戦前に迫る
item.description:
Alex Lawler Olesya Astakhova
[ロンドン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alex Lawler　Olesya Astakhova

[ロンドン １１日 ロイター] - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）とロシアなど非加盟産油国でつくる「ＯＰＥＣプラス」の１０月の原油生産量が前月比で大幅に増加した。ＯＰＥＣが１１日に公表した月報で明らかになった。イランでの戦争に起因するホルムズ海峡経由の輸送混乱が続く中でも、サウジアラビアの生産が大きく増えて全体を押し上げた。

ＯＰＥＣによると、ＯＰＥＣプラスの１０月の原油生産量は日量４１２３万バレルで、９月から約２０４万バレル増加した。

生産量の増加は、ペルシャ湾岸産油国が船舶間移送（ＳＴＳ）などの代替手段を活用し、紛争による物流障害を回避しながら輸出を回復させていることを改めて示している。

ＯＰＥＣ統計に基づくロイターの試算では、１０月の生産量は、ＯＰＥＣプラスが２月に記録した日量４２７２万バレルの９７％に相当する水準となった。

サウジがＯＰＥＣに報告した１０月の生産量は日量１０５６万３０００バレルで、９月の日量８３７万２０００バレルから大幅に増加し、２月の日量１０８８万２０００バレル以来の高水準となった。同国はこれまでも市場の供給混乱時には増産し、供給過剰の懸念がある場合には減産するなど、原油市場の安定化に向けて介入してきた。

ロシアの１０月の原油生産量は日量８６６万８０００バレルとなり、９月から４万１０００バレル増加した。

ＯＰＥＣは、６カ月連続で下方修正していた世界の石油需要予測を据え置き、２０２７年の見通しについても変更しなかった。今年は日量１８万バレル需要が増加し、２７年は日量２５５万バレル増の平均１億０８３０万バレルに達するとみている。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（11日）米利上げ観測でドル上昇、株反発
item.description: ＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（11日）米利上げ観測でドル上昇、株反発 7:20 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所。11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。 ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１５９．８４円。約２カ月ぶりの高値を付け、心理的な節目の１ドル＝１６０円に迫った。 ユーロは０．６５％安の１．１１ドル。前営業日から下げが続き、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。 ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。 ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。 英ポンドは０．５０％安の１．３３ドルと、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。ドルは対スイスフランで１０月中旬以来の高値を付けた後、０．９３％高の０．８３３スイスフランとなった。 ドル指数は０．６８％高の１０２．９０となった。一時、２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。 暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．９３％高の７万４４６０．４１ドル。イーサリアムは１．１９％高の２０７９．３１ドルとなった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 休場

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。 これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。 同社は２０２８年上期に調整後ベースで黒字化するとの見通しを示した。nL6N46R1FZ ＡＩインフラ関連株全般で投資家心理が改善し、ネビウス・グループは１５．４％、アプライド・デジタルは７．４％それぞれ急伸した。 エヌビディアも上昇した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と、中国のスパイとの疑いが持たれている女性との関係が投資家の懸念を招き、直前の２営業日で時価総額が約４３００億ドル消失していた。 株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。先週の中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことを受け、投資家の間ではＡＩ分野の規制強化への懸念が浮上。エヌビディアのＣＥＯを巡る不安と相まって、現在の強気相場を支える主要な柱の一つであるＡＩ株に圧力がかかった。 投資家が原油価格の下落を好感する一方、米国債利回りの急上昇を招いたインフレ圧力の強さを示す指標を懸念していることも、株価の不安定な動きにつながっている。 グローバルトのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「誰もが毎日、『炭鉱のカナリア』（危険の予兆）を探し、それに日々反応している」と指摘。「ＡＩは良い、いやそれほど良くないという見方の間を、何度も行き来している。心配だと言ったかと思えば、今度は素晴らしいとなる」と語った。 フィラデルフィア半導体指数は５．７％急伸し、終値として１１月３日以来の高値を付けた。全構成銘柄が上昇した。 最近の強い売り圧力を受け、一部の投資家は押し目買いに動いた。ただ、初期の指標を見る限り、警戒を解くのは時期尚早だ。 バンク・オブ・アメリカ・グローバル・リサーチのアナリストはリポートで、先週の急落局面でも投資家は株式を購入していたと指摘。純流入は全て上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を通じたもので、機関投資家が買いを主導したという。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米国のインフレ指標が市場予想を上回り、ＦＲＢ高官によるタカ派的な発言も重なったことで、ドル高が進み、金相場は続落した。

１２月限の清算値は前日比０．７％安の１オンス＝４０００．５０ドル。金現物は一時４０６６．７７ドルまで戻したが、午後には１．１％安の３９８６．７９ドルとなり、前日の約３％安に続く下落となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は、約１％上昇した。イランの安全保障担当トップが濃縮核物質の国外搬出を認めないと述べたことを受け、供給懸念が再燃した。前営業日に付けた約２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。 北海ブレント先物の清算値は、前日比１．２７ドル（１．３９％）高の１バレル＝９２．７６ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４９ドル（０．５７％）高の８６．５３ドルだった。 イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。また、米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。 米政府は、イランとの戦争終結を目指す初期の交渉では、核問題を議題に含めなければならないとの立場を示している。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、米利上げ観測で　円は160円に迫る 7:16 配信

2026年11月4日、日本の東京にある証券会社の外に設置された電光掲示板の前を、歩行者たちが通り過ぎていく。電光掲示板には、米ドルに対する現在の日本円の為替レートが表示されていた。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１５９．８４円。約２カ月ぶりの高値を付け、心理的な節目の１ドル＝１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６５％安の１．１１ドル。前営業日から下げが続き、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．５０％安の１．３３ドルと、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。ドルは対スイスフランで１０月中旬以来の高値を付けた後、０．９３％高の０．８３３スイスフランとなった。

item.title: サウジ、フーシ派のミサイルなど迎撃 連合軍「リヤドやメッカ標的」
item.description: [ドバイ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ １１日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアの防空部隊は１１日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が首都リヤドやイスラム教の聖地メッカなどに向けて発射したミサイルと無人機（ドローン）を迎撃した。

フーシ派と戦うサウジ主導の軍事連合によると、リヤド地域に向けられた巡航ミサイル３発、メッカと南部地域を狙ったドローン２機、西部に向けられたミサイル２発を迎撃・破壊した。

世界中のイスラム教徒にとって聖地であるメッカは、イスラム教で最も神聖な都市であり、イスラム教の五行の一つである毎年の大巡礼（ハッジ）の中心地だ。

フーシ派の軍報道官ヤヒヤ・サレア氏はその後、ドローンでメッカを標的にしたことを否定し、同組織の作戦は石油施設と軍事基地を標的にしていると述べた。

サレア氏はまた、ホルムズ海峡が封鎖される中で輸出を可能にしているサウジの主要な石油拠点ヤンブーのポンプ施設を攻撃したと述べた。このフーシ派の声明についてサウジ側の確認は得られていない。

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、年内の成果に期待 「米ロ協議の行方が鍵」
item.description:
Padraic Halpin
[ダブリン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Padraic Halpin

[ダブリン １１日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１１日、ロシアとの戦争終結を巡る協議で年内に具体的な成果を得たいと表明した。ただ、米国がロシアにどのような姿勢で臨むかに多くがかかっていると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ウクライナとロシアの交渉担当者がアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の首都アブダビで米国主導の協議を２日間行った後、アイルランドのマーティン首相と共同記者会見を行った。

ゼレンスキー氏は記者会見で「多くは、明日の米ロ双方の対話の形式にかかっている。今われわれが目にしている状況を踏まえれば、米国にとっても年内に成果を上げることが非常に重要だと思う。そして、米国は本当にそれを強く望んでいるように見える」と述べた。

アブダビで行われたロシアとウクライナ、米国の協議は、２日間の日程を終え、捕虜交換などで一定の進展があった。ただ、戦争終結に向けた具体的な動きに関する発表はほとんどなかった。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏とトランプ米政権のウィットコフ中東担当特使は１２日にモスクワを訪れてプーチン氏と会談し、協議を欧州のパートナーにも広げる問題を提起する。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝反発、コアウィーブ決算受けＡＩ投資巡る懸念後退
item.description:
Chuck Mikolajczak Utkarsh Hathi
［ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター］ - 米国株式...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝反発、コアウィーブ決算受けＡＩ投資巡る懸念後退 7:11 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Chuck Mikolajczak　Utkarsh Hathi

［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。

これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。 同社は２０２８年上期に調整後ベースで黒字化するとの見通しを示した。

ＡＩインフラ関連株全般で投資家心理が改善し、ネビウス・グループは１５．４％、アプライド・デジタルは７．４％それぞれ急伸した。

エヌビディアも上昇した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と、中国のスパイとの疑いが持たれている女性との関係が投資家の懸念を招き、直前の２営業日で時価総額が約４３００億ドル消失していた。

株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。先週の中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことを受け、投資家の間ではＡＩ分野の規制強化への懸念が浮上。エヌビディアのＣＥＯを巡る不安と相まって、現在の強気相場を支える主要な柱の一つであるＡＩ株に圧力がかかった。

投資家が原油価格の下落を好感する一方、米国債利回りの急上昇を招いたインフレ圧力の強さを示す指標を懸念していることも、株価の不安定な動きにつながっている。

グローバルトのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「誰もが毎日、『炭鉱のカナリア』（危険の予兆）を探し、それに日々反応している」と指摘。「ＡＩは良い、いやそれほど良くないという見方の間を、何度も行き来している。心配だと言ったかと思えば、今度は素晴らしいとなる」と語った。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は５．７％急伸し、終値として１１月３日以来の高値を付けた。全構成銘柄が上昇した。

最近の強い売り圧力を受け、一部の投資家は押し目買いに動いた。ただ、初期の指標を見る限り、警戒を解くのは時期尚早だ。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ・グローバル・リサーチのアナリストはリポートで、先週の急落局面でも投資家は株式を購入していたと指摘。純流入は全て上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を通じたもので、機関投資家が買いを主導したという。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の情報技術株指数は２．７％上昇し、主要１１セクターで最大の上昇率となった。４営業日のうち３営業日で上昇している。

「恐怖指数」と呼ばれるＶＩＸ指数は４営業日続落し、１週間ぶりの低水準となる１７．４９で引けた。先週は約７カ月ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

投資家は、ＡＩ開発のアンソロピックが１０日に示した新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の条件にも注目した。調達額は最大６４４億ドル、評価額は最大１兆４０００億ドルとなる見通しだ。バンダ・リサーチはリポートで、このＩＰＯに伴う個人投資家の１日の買い付け額がスペースＸを上回り、過去最大級となる可能性があると指摘した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．４８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダック市場では１．７７対１で値上がり銘柄数が多かった。

米取引所の出来高は１４７億４０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均１８６億８０００万株を下回った。

item.title: Australian companies face 'AI washing' claims after wave of job cuts, offshoring
item.description: SYDNEY, Nov 12 : Australia's blue-chip companies are increasingly invoking artificial intelligence as they cut jobs and move work offshore, unions and experts say, complicating the government's efforts to support employment in a slowing economy.On Tuesday, Qantas, Australia's flag carrier, said it would cut 8

item.content:encoded:

Australian companies face 'AI washing' claims after wave of job cuts, offshoring

A Qantas plane takes off at Sydney Airport in Sydney, Australia, November 6, 2026. REUTERS/Jeremy Piper

12 Nov 2026 05:01AM

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 12 : Australia's blue-chip companies are increasingly invoking artificial intelligence as they cut jobs and move work offshore, unions and experts say, complicating the government's efforts to support employment in a slowing economy. On Tuesday, Qantas, Australia's flag carrier, said it would cut 850 jobs and outsource some corporate functions offshore as part of an AI-driven overhaul with consulting firm Accenture, a move that has raised accusations of "AI washing." "AI washing" describes a practice by companies of attributing layoffs to AI tools when the primary driver may be broader cost-cutting measures, such as shifting jobs offshore. Tech companies WiseTech and Atlassian have cut jobs this year, attributing the losses to AI. Telecommunications firm Telstra has also cut jobs from an AI joint venture with Accenture, with some work offshored to India.

More broadly, other firms across corporate Australia have also slashed their domestic headcounts while expanding operations in India, the Philippines and Vietnam, though they did not explicitly mention AI in their announcements. When asked about the Qantas job cuts, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, who was unveiling the response to a recent breach of a government website by an OpenAI agent, said AI "represents an enormous opportunity and a major economic issue." Labour unions have argued that Australian workers were not being replaced by AI, but by lower-paid offshore employees. "Unions are concerned about the risk of companies using AI simply as a cover to cut Australian jobs with no accountability," said Australian Council of Trade Unions Secretary Melissa Donnelly. "From Qantas to the big banks, workers deserve transparency and genuine consultation over decisions that impact their jobs and lives." The Australian Services Union, which represents the affected Qantas workers, accused the airline of "using AI to launder their cuts to Australian jobs." "We expect to see more of this cost cutting and race to the bottom if corporate Australia continues to copy this failed tactic," said Assistant National Secretary Scott Cowen. Senator Barbara Pocock, a member of the Australian Greens party, said on Wednesday that she was concerned to see big companies engaging in "AI washing," using the technology as an excuse to cut jobs. "AI is transforming our workplaces and economy but that's no excuse to let it run rampant," Pocock said in a statement. A Qantas spokesperson said in a statement it would continue to consult with unions and that it was focused on "redeployment opportunities" and support for impacted staff. Qantas did not respond to the concerns around 'AI washing'. Atlassian, WiseTech and Telstra did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TREND TO CONTINUE Further job cuts by companies could pose headaches for Australia's centre-left Labor government, with recent polls showing its approval ratings steadily falling amid high cost-of-living pressures. The central bank has raised interest rates five times so far this year to their highest level in 18 years amid persistent inflation, while the latest data showed the unemployment rate at a five-year high of 4.7 per cent. Uri Gal, a professor at the University of Sydney Business School, said a growing number of companies were blaming job cuts on AI, but "we should therefore be cautious about accepting AI as the primary explanation." "There are real incentives to engage in AI washing," he said. "A company that announces job cuts to reduce costs may face criticism, whereas one that presents the same decision as part of an AI transformation can appear innovative and forward-looking." Gal said the Qantas decision appeared to be due to conventional outsourcing and demonstrated how AI can help justify restructuring before the technology's productivity gains have materialised. "The company has announced that some corporate functions will be transferred to Accenture, primarily in India, and explicitly states that these functions will subsequently be transformed through AI and automation," Gal said. "This raises an obvious question: if AI is making these jobs redundant, why does the work first need to be transferred to another group of employees?" The Reserve Bank of Australia said this week AI had not yet led to widespread job losses, though it noted "tentative signs of adjustment," with job ads weakening in AI-exposed occupations and employment growing more strongly in less affected roles. A government spokesperson said in a statement it expected Australian workers to see the benefits of new technologies and that employers should invest in upskilling them to adopt AI.

Source: Reuters

FAST

PARIS, Nov 11 : France's Alexia Barrier became the first woman to complete the Route du Rhum in the Ultim class on Wednesday, finishing fifth after a punishing transatlantic race that forced three of the eight giant trimarans to retire. The 46-year-old crossed the finish line in Pointe-a-Pitre at 1542 local time on Wednesday (1942 GMT) aboard IDEC Sport-CIC, completing the 3,542-nautical-mile race from Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe in 10 days, 7 hours and 40 minutes. She arrived more than three days behind her compatriot Tom Laperche, who skippered SVR-Lazartigue to victory in the Ultim class in record time. Thomas Coville, aboard Sodebo Ultim 3, was second and Louis Burton, skipper of Armand Thiery, took third, with LIAMM skipper Guirec Soudee finishing just off the podium.

Barrier struggled to match the leaders aboard IDEC Sport-CIC, the oldest Ultim in the fleet, launched in 2006. Ultim trimarans can measure up to 32 metres long and 23 metres wide (105 feet by 75 feet). But the strength and reliability of her boat enabled Barrier to finish the quadrennial race when three of her rivals failed to make it across the Atlantic. Armel Le Cleac'h, skipper of Maxi Banque Populaire XI, capsized off the Azores last Wednesday, three days after the start. The 2016-17 Vendee Globe winner was later rescued by a Panamanian cargo ship. Defending champion Charles Caudrelier retired from the race after suffering foil damage to his new Maxi Edmond de Rothschild-Gitana 18, while Actual Ultim 4 skipper Anthony Marchand withdrew because of a major problem with his central rudder. Barrier also endured problems of her own, attempting to repair a torn mainsail before encountering a winch issue in the closing days of the race. One of only 13 women to complete the Vendee Globe, Barrier also led the first all-female crew to complete the Jules Verne Trophy course 10 months ago and has again broken new ground in a discipline long dominated by men. Her next target is the Arkea Ultim Challenge, a solo race around the world for giant Ultim class trimarans, whose second edition is due to start in January 2028.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 原油先物1％高、イランが核物質の国外搬出認めず 供給懸念再燃
item.description:
Nicole Jao
[ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao

[ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、約１％上昇した。イランの安全保障担当トップが濃縮核物質の国外搬出を認めないと述べたことを受け、供給懸念が再燃した。前営業日に付けた約２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。

北海ブレント先物の清算値は、前日比１．２７ドル（１．３９％）高の１バレル＝９２．７６ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４９ドル（０．５７％）高の８６．５３ドルだった。

イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。また、米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。

米政府は、イランとの戦争終結を目指す初期の交渉では、核問題を議題に含めなければならないとの立場を示している。

item.title: 駐米ロシア大使が死去、66歳 対米関係改善を主導
item.description: [モスクワ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １１日 ロイター] - ロシア外務省は１１日、駐米ロシア大使のアレクサンドル・ダルチエフ氏が死去したと発表した。６６歳だった。

プーチン大統領は２０２５年３月、ベテラン外交官のダルチエフ氏を駐米大使に任命した。同氏はかつて公の場で西側を非難したことで知られ、トランプ米政権との関係改善を主導する役割を担っていた。米とロシアの関係改善は、ウクライナや欧州諸国に動揺を与えていた。

Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles, drones; group denies targeting Mecca

Reuters

12 November, 2026 01:30 am IST

Follow Us:

X

-->

DUBAI, Nov 11 (Reuters) – Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi missiles and drones launched towards Riyadh, Mecca and other regions on Wednesday, as hostilities between the Iran-aligned group and the kingdom worsen.

The Saudi-led military coalition fighting the Yemeni group said it had intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles headed to the Riyadh region, two drones aimed at Mecca and southern areas and two missiles pointed towards the west.

Mecca, home to sites sacred to Muslims worldwide, is Islam’s holiest city and the focal point of the annual hajj pilgrimage, one of the five pillars of Islam, which millions of Muslims undertake each year.

Show Full Article

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree later denied targeting Mecca with a drone, saying the group’s operations target oil facilities and military bases.

Saree also said the Houthis had attacked a pumping station in Saudi Arabia’s Yanbu, a key Saudi oil hub that allows exports to avoid the blocked Strait of Hormuz. There was no Saudi confirmation of the Houthi statement.

Saudi civil defence issued alerts warning of potential danger in the cities of Taif, Yanbu and Khamis Mushait later on Wednesday, then announced the danger had passed, state television reported.

The militia, which controls most of the populous parts of Yemen, has intensified attacks on the Saudi capital in recent days, saying it was responding to Saudi attacks in Yemen. A Houthi attack on Sunday damaged an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh’s financial hub.

Wednesday’s interceptions marked the second consecutive day that Saudi air defences had intercepted Houthi missiles launched towards Riyadh, after they downed a ballistic missile and a cruise missile on Tuesday, the coalition said.

Last month, a Houthi attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed 13 people and wounded more than 300.

Renewed fighting between the two sides has intensified since September, when the Houthis advanced towards the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a strategic shipping chokepoint at the southern entrance to the Red Sea.

The Houthis have since stepped up strikes on Saudi airports, ports and oil facilities, while Saudi Arabia has ramped up airstrikes on Houthi targets in Yemen in response.

(Reporting by Nayera Abdallah, Jana Choukeir, Yomna Ehab and Ahmed TolbaEditing by Ros Russell, Peter Graff, Philippa Fletcher and Cynthia Osterman)

Democrats are ready to fight Trump on immigration. But how much can they achieve?

Reuters

12 November, 2026 01:30 am IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

By Julia Harte, Kristina Cooke and Richard Cowan Nov 11 (Reuters) – Democratic lawmakers are gearing up to fight President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown when in control of Congress next year, targeting ICE tactics and expanding paths to legal status despite limits on how much they can achieve.

Democrats handily won control of both chambers of Congress last week, fueled in part by voters’ dissatisfaction with Trump’s aggressive arrest and deportation campaign. But lawmakers from both parties expect Stephen Miller, the architect of that campaign and Trump’s new chief of staff, to go on driving immigration policy.

House and Senate staffers told Reuters they expect the president to veto any legislation that would curb immigration enforcement or expand pathways to legal residency and citizenship.

Show Full Article

Trump’s immigration crackdown has become a political vulnerability, with his approval on the issue falling to 38% from 50% at the start of his presidency, based on Reuters/Ipsos polling, and Latino voters swinging sharply back to Democrats in the midterms after tilting Republican in 2024.

In a Friday interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes,” Trump acknowledged his deportation strategy may have been “too tough.” Asked about that by reporters on Monday, Trump responded: “My policy has not changed.”

Democrats will have more latitude on oversight. They have already drawn up a list of investigative targets at the Department of Homeland Security, the parent agency of Immigration and Customs Enforcement, according to staffers, including detention center conditions, fatal use of force by federal agents and the 2025 deportation of Venezuelans to a Salvadoran megaprison.

“We will investigate the administration weaponizing DHS against Americans (and) its out of control immigration policies,” US Representative Bennie Thompson, a Mississippi Democrat and the soon-to-be chair of the House Homeland Security Committee, told Reuters in a statement.

The party also plans to push for greater transparency into how DHS is spending the more than $100 billion allocated by Congress since last year, staffers said, speaking on condition of anonymity.

At a Wednesday press conference at the US Capitol with House members and newly elected representatives from southwestern border states, Henry Cuellar, a centrist Texas Democrat, said he had already had conversations with Trump officials about focusing deportation efforts on criminals.

“We’re not going to be extreme,” Cuellar said, nodding to conservative voters across the United States who cast their votes for Democrats.

Asked for a response to this story, White House spokesperson Taylor Rogers told Reuters in a statement: “The Democrats are colossally misreading the electorate if they think the American people want an extremist, anti-American immigration agenda.”

The Department of Homeland Security did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.

The Democratic Party is in a “whole new world when it comes to their immigration agenda,” said Sarah Pierce, social policy director at the center-left Third Way think tank.

“They’ve clearly broken from the policy that we saw under the Biden administration, but they have yet to offer a proactive vision for what immigration should look like.”

Democrat Joe Biden, president from 2021 to 2025, initially rolled back some of the restrictive immigration policies of Trump’s first four-year term before taking a tougher approach to the border late in his presidency.

REINING IN ICE

Some Democrats emerged from last week’s midterm elections ready for battle.

“We will rip ICE apart,” Senator-elect Peggy Flanagan said while celebrating her triumph in Minnesota, where federal immigration agents shot dead two US citizens during an enforcement surge in January.

US Representative Pramila Jayapal, a Washington state Democrat and the ranking member of the House Judiciary Committee’s immigration subcommittee, pledged to summon “every single one of these corrupt people that kidnapped and detained and deported and killed people in the streets.”

Just the specter of having to testify on Capitol Hill could change the behavior of federal officials, a Democratic congressional staffer said.

In a statement to Reuters, Josh Gottheimer, a moderate Democratic representative from New Jersey, highlighted the ICE Standards Act, which he introduced in March.

“Agents need real training and body cameras,” he said. “They need to wear clear identification unless they are on an undercover operation. They must coordinate with state and local law enforcement.”

Republicans counter that they have already provided ICE with funding to purchase body cameras and have resisted Democratic attempts to place further guardrails on the agency.

On the campaign trail in 2024, Trump made no secret of his plans for an immigration crackdown. But the tactics of masked, armed federal agents, first in Minneapolis and then across the country, generated widespread outrage.

REFORMING THE SYSTEM

Jose Parra, a former US Senate aide with knowledge of current congressional discussions on immigration, said “voters moved the goal posts” last week, potentially opening the way for some stalled bills to advance.

He pointed to the Dignity Act, a bipartisan bill that would create a path to legal residence for workers while tightening border security and reforming visa programs.

Another bill likely to gain traction, Parra said, is the Dream and Promise Act, which would open a pathway to US citizenship for immigrants who arrived as children, known as “Dreamers.”

Despite Gallup polling that shows more than 80% of Americans support a legal pathway for Dreamers, even that legislation might be difficult to advance, according to a senior Senate Republican aide, who said any serious attempt would likely come closer to the next presidential election.

Parra agreed with that assessment, saying Republicans might want to “take that off the table and not let it be a messaging cudgel against them in 2028.”

Trump’s veto power will likely be an insurmountable barrier to enacting comprehensive immigration reform or clawing back the tens of billions of dollars already appropriated to ICE.

“Congress has ceded so much of its authority and so much of its power to the executive,” said Claire Trickler-McNulty, a former senior ICE official. “There are real limitations on how much Congress can do.”

Still, she said, lawmakers could use funding deadlines and Senate confirmation votes as leverage. And they could pass measures redirecting ICE funding to popular programs like healthcare or school lunches, even if the bills die on Trump’s desk.

At Wednesday’s press conference, US Senator Ruben Gallego, Democrat of Arizona, said his party will have to cut deals with Trump, and that members were already discussing how to move forward with a Dreamers bill by the end of 2026.

“Republicans have been saying we will have immigration reform as soon as we have a safe, secure border,” Gallego said. “We have that right now.”

(Reporting by Julia Harte in New York, Kristina Cooke in San Francisco and Richard Cowan in Washington. Editing by Jesse Mesner-Hage and Howard Goller)

Nov 11 : Australia centre Len Ikitau said the Wallabies must change their mindset for Sunday's test against Scotland at Murrayfield or risk another damaging defeat after last weekend’s record loss to England. The 2027 World Cup hosts went down 45-22 at Twickenham on Sunday, the most points Australia have conceded in a test against England. They face a Scotland side also seeking a response after losing heavily to New Zealand. "England kind of gave it to us from the start and put us on a load of pressure and played the way that they wanted to play and we kind of sat back and watched them," Ikitau said. "We can't be doing that against Scotland; we really want to be going out there, especially in defence, and put them under the pressure.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（11日） 3:21 配信

＜外為市場＞

ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１ドル＝１５９．８３円となり、２カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。心理的な節目である１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６１％安の１．１１ドルに下落し、前営業日からの下げを拡大して２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．４７％安の１．３３ドルとなり、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。一方、ドルは対スイスフランで０．８６％高の０．８３２フランとなり、１０月半ば以来の高値を付けた。

ドル指数は０．６３％高の１０２．８５。一時、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．１６％高の７万３８９０．４８ドル。イーサは０．８５％高の２０７２．４０ドルとなった。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

ＦＴＳＥ１００種指数が上昇して取引を終えた。原油と銅の価格上昇を受け、エネルギー株と鉱業株が買われた。

中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．７２％上昇した。

エネルギー株指数は１．７％上昇し、８営業日ぶりに反発した。原油価格が前日に付けた２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。

石油大手ＢＰは２．７％高、シェルは１．３％高だった。

産業用金属・鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇に連れ、１．８％近く上昇した。

アングロ・アメリカン、アントファガスタ、グレンコアはいずれも２．２─２．３％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

終値で過去最高値を更新し、取引時間中の最高値にも迫った。シーメンス・エナジーと米コアウィーブの明るい業績見通しが人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への信頼感を高め、テクノロジー株を押し上げた。

欧州株価指数ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種は０．７２％高の６６３．０５で取引を終え、取引時間中の最高値６６３．４１まであとわずかに迫った。

ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は１．２％上昇し、欧州の主要市場を上回る値上がりとなった。

ＡＩ関連機器を手がけるシーメンス・エナジーが１０．８％急伸した。２０２７年の利益率見通しを引き上げ、配当を３倍超に増やす計画を発表した。

同業のシュナイダーエレクトリックとルグランはそれぞれ３％、２．２％上昇。テクノロジー株指数は２．５％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りがおおむね横ばいとなった。前日に発表された強い米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）を受けて米国債市場が動揺し、欧州にも影響が波及したが、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。

米債券市場はベテランズデーの祝日で休場となり、市場の流動性が低下。世界的に取引が低調となった。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは直近で１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．３２％。

市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ観測が強まり、１２月の利上げは確実視されるようになった。

米経済の重要性を踏まえ、この統計を受けて欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１２月に利上げするとの見方もやや強まり、現在はほぼ確実視されている。

金融政策に敏感なドイツ２年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇し、３．１０％となった。１０日には８ｂｐ上昇していた。

足元の原油価格の動きは、利回りの低下を支持している。北海ブレント先物は８月下旬以来の安値付近まで下落した。これが、売り圧力にさらされてきたフランス国債に一定の安心感をもたらした。

フランス１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇の４．８０％。１０日には７ｂｐ上昇していた。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐで横ばいだった。１０月には１７８ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

スペイン１０年債利回りも１ｂｐ上昇した。スペインでは住宅問題への怒りを背景に労働者が１４年ぶりのゼネストに踏み切ったが、市場は材料視しなかった。

(This story has been repeated to fix a typo in the headline.) LONDON, Nov 11 : Harry Kane has spent much of the last decade rewriting the record books and on Thursday the striker will add another chapter when he becomes England's most-capped men's player with his 126th appearance against Croatia. Before kickoff at Wembley, the 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward will present the Ballon d'Or trophy he won last month to England's fans before moving past former goalkeeper Peter Shilton's long-standing record. "Definitely up there with the biggest (achievements of my career)," England captain Kane told reporters at former club Tottenham Hotspur's training ground on Wednesday after being given a standing ovation when he entered the room.

"It showcases consistency at the highest level and to reach the number of caps I have is a testament to the things I spoke about in my (Ballon d'Or) speech behind the scenes, the dedication and for sure it is one of the biggest milestones of my career." Kane is never one to shout his name from the rooftops, but having moved past Wayne Rooney's England scoring record of 53 goals in 2023 he has surged to 91 and ranks among his country's all-time greats, even if ending England's long wait for a major trophy has remained elusive. England manager Thomas Tuchel said Kane was the "perfect captain and a leader by example" and described his playing style as unique, adding that he is getting smarter with age. Asked if Kane is England's greatest player, Tuchel said: "I don't know but he is up there of course. It's now proven and it's always nice if things are proven. "He has his collection of prizes, he will score more goals, he will get more games and tomorrow he will start as captain of course. It's a big occasion to present the Ballon d'Or to our fans and bring it to the country and when he gets his all-time record for 126 matches. "It's a beautiful, beautiful occasion." PRESENTATION AT WEMBLEY Kane will be honoured in a pre-match presentation at Wembley before the UEFA Nations League match against Croatia with Shilton, who has held the England appearance record since 1989, also involved. Only a handful of active men's internationals have made more appearances for their countries than Kane, whose England debut came as a substitute against Lithuania in 2015 when he scored little more than a minute after coming on. Once the anthems have been sung and the record secured, Kane's attention will turn to the next target in a career that continues to gather milestones. "We spoke in the last camp about the 100 goals for England, I think that's another incredible milestone to try and reach as soon as possible," said Kane, who scored a remarkable 73 goals in 65 games for Bayern Munich and England last season. "Right now, I'm feeling really, really good so hopefully many more years to see what else I can achieve. "To win a team trophy with England, a major trophy, is my biggest dream. I know how difficult that is so extremely motivated to do that."

Source: Reuters

item.description: Spain also prepared for heavy rain and flooding, with over 3,000 people evacuated due to the risk of a dam overflowing.

LISBON: Airlines cancelled more than 200 flights in and out of Portugal , while schools and hundreds of supermarkets and businesses closed on Wednesday (Nov 11) as Storm Charles made landfall, bringing heavy downpours and gale-force winds. Although the storm was less severe than initially expected, the government, criticised for its slow response to a succession of storm s in January and February, had taken pre-emptive steps, putting all emergency services and army units on alert, cancelling classes, shutting non-essential public services and advising people to stay indoors. Portugal 's weather service IPMA said the eye of the storm had split in two over the Atlantic, diminishing its strength when it arrived via the southern Algarve region. It was expected to reach most of southern Portugal and the Lisbon region through late afternoon. Civil Protection Commander Mario Silvestre said authorities were maintaining high alert levels for flash floods, wind and rough seas after registering 538 incidents since midnight.

Storm Charles had already swept through the Madeira archipelago, causing some flooding and felling trees. Emergency services rescued a man swept away when water flooded his garage on the island of Madeira, but no casualties were reported. Since Sunday, Portugal and neighbouring Spain have been pummelled by heavy rains brought by Storm Bruna, with flooding reported in several areas including road tunnels in Lisbon, which were mostly shut on Wednesday. The new storm was expected to reach southwestern Spain on Wednesday afternoon, with the country's weather service AEMET warning of "serious or very serious" impact from heavy rain, strong winds and rough seas that could exacerbate conditions caused by Storm Bruna. In central Spain, authorities maintained the evacuation of more than 3,000 people in Piedralaves, whom they removed from their homes on Tuesday due to the risk of a local dam overflowing, and warned that rainfall was expected to intensify from midday.

(Refiles to widen distribution) Nov 11 : Anthropic could see record buying by retail investors in its market debut, potentially surpassing SpaceX and making it one of the biggest single-day retail purchases in history, Vanda Research said in a note on Wednesday. The research firm expects Anthropic's debut to attract about $250 million in net retail buying, based on its analysis of retail activity on listing days and the volume of its pre-IPO perpetual futures traded on Hyperliquid. This would be twice SpaceX's IPO record of $118 million in retail buying. "Judging by pre-IPO perp trading, Anthropic is shaping up to be a record retail IPO," Viraj Patel, global macro strategist at Vanda Research said, in the note.

Pre-IPO perpetual futures are a type of derivative contract which trade on exchanges like Hyperliquid and Coinbase, and allow traders to bet on private companies' valuation. They have no direct link to the underlying shares but are priced with reference to the company's latest disclosed pre-IPO valuation. Only six stocks have topped $250 million in single-day retail buying since 2024, the data firm added. "Anthropic next week could draw the kind of retail buying that we've rarely seen in our data," Vanda said. Anthropic is targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its IPO, with shares expected to start trading on the Nasdaq on November 19.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 欧州外為市場＝ドル上昇、米12月利上げ織り込む ユーロ1年半ぶり安値
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター］ - 欧州外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州外為市場＝ドル上昇、米12月利上げ織り込む　ユーロ1年半ぶり安値 2:07 配信

2026年10月29日撮影 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 欧州外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１ドル＝１５９．８３円となり、２カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。心理的な節目である１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６１％安の１．１１ドルに下落し、前営業日からの下げを拡大して２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．４７％安の１．３３ドルとなり、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。一方、ドルは対スイスフランで０．８６％高の０．８３２フランとなり、１０月半ば以来の高値を付けた。

ドル指数は０．６３％高の１０２．８５。一時、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．１６％高の７万３８９０．４８ドル。イーサは０．８５％高の２０７２．４０ドルとなった。

item.title: Millions of Spaniards stage first general strike in 14 years as anger rages over housing
item.description: MADRID: Four million Spanish workers took part in a general strike on Wednesday (Nov 11), unions said, enduring stormy weather to set up picket lines in a protest against the country's
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Millions of Spaniards stage first general strike in 14 years as anger rages over housing

Protesters carry a banner reading “Speculation No. Guarantee The Right To Housing”, during a strike over soaring housing costs and stagnant wages, in Bilbao, Spain, Nov 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Vincent West)

12 Nov 2026 12:29AM (Updated: 12 Nov 2026 01:36AM)

FAST

MADRID: Four million Spanish workers t ook part in a general strike on Wednesday (Nov 11), unions said, enduring stormy weather to set up picket lines in a protest against the country's housing affordability crisis less than three weeks before a snap general election. It is the first general strike since workers downed tools in 2012 against austerity measures during the euro zone debt crisis. The walkout is backed by Spain's two largest unions, UGT and CCOO, representing more than a million workers, as well as tenants' associations angry about rising rents and evictions. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez hopes to harness voter resentment over housing in the Nov 29 election to shift the political narrative away from corruption cases involving his inner circle and a deadly train crash last month. So far, his Socialist Party still trails in opinion polls. Unions described the strike as a success even though participation was uneven across Spain, with the strongest support in coastal regions where housing pressures have been particularly acute.

SHOPS SHUTTERED On Madrid's Gran Via, one of the capital's main shopping streets, protesters cheered as stores including Primark, H&M and Pull & Bear drew their shutters amid a heavy riot police presence. "We're going to close the Mango store," the protesters chanted as they jangled sets of house keys above their heads. Many shops in Barcelona were also closed and boarded up in anticipation of unrest. Spain has a deficit of about 750,000 homes, which is set to grow to more than a million by 2028, according to the central bank. With fewer people able to afford a home, renting has increased sharply, putting pressure on that market. The average rental price of €1,176 (US$1,315) is equivalent to about 98.7 per cent of a young person's average monthly salary in Spain, according to the Youth Council of Spain. "I’m 36 years old and I still can’t move out on my own," said Madrid resident Jesus Gonzalez , who works in a hospital IT department and supports the strike . "Rents just keep going up, house prices just keep going up, and it’s simply impossible."

Smoke rises after fireworks exploded next to demonstrators, during a 24-hour nationwide general strike in Barcelona, Spain, Nov 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Albert Gea)

TURNOUT STRONGEST AT PORTS, AUTO PLANTS Angela de Miguel, vice president of Spain's main business lobby CEOE, said the strike was counterproductive because small businesses were also affected by the housing crisis, since shortages of homes made recruitment more challenging. Speaking on state broadcaster TVE, she said the solution was to build more homes and to lower taxes in construction and the home-buying process. Plans for massive protest marches in the afternoon were threatened by two heavy storms, dubbed Charles and Bruna , with unions suspending a demonstration in the southern port city of Cadiz. T he tenants' union said it still expected participation in the strike to reach 5 million people by the end of the day. Spain has around 23 million workers, according to the national statistics institute. According to UGT and CCOO, participation in the strike reached 90 per cent at ports and in the automotive sector, with "total stoppages" reported at factories including Volkswagen's in Navarre and SEAT's in Barcelona. Electricity demand dropped by as much as 15.5 per cent between 10am and 11am, according to Spain's grid operator Red Electrica.

Related:

CNA Explains: Why are violent Gen Z protests breaking out across Europe?

Thousands march in Madrid to protest Spain's housing crisis after eviction of 87-year-old woman

LESS IMPACT DUE TO REMOTE WORKING Barcelona's metro said no trains would run outside peak commuting hours, while Madrid's metro said peak-hour usage was down 42 per cent compared to the same period last week. However, w ith more people able to work remotely and the increasing weight of services in Spain’s economy, the impact of the strike is likely to be less pronounced than in previous years , according to Miguel Cardoso, chief economist at BBVA Research. He estimated that the strike could shave 0.1 per cent-0.2 per cent off Spain’s annual gross domestic product. Spain's fast-growing hospitality and finance industries are less unionised than the public and industrial sectors. P olice had reported 40 arrests by midday from 476 incidents linked to the general strike , including blockades of offices and industrial estates and burning of rubbish containers. Unions said they would file a criminal complaint against what they described as a “disproportionate” response during a police operation involving tear gas and batons that left 20 protesters injured. The strike follows weeks of demonstrations provoked by the eviction and subsequent death of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid. Those protests, along with parliament's rejection last month of g over nment decrees aimed at curbing evictions and limiting rent pressures, prompted Sanchez to call the snap election.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.description: ［１１日 ロイター］ - ベセント米財務長官が、シンガポールを拠点とするクラウドコンピューティング企業メガスピード...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米財務長官、商務長官を追及　エヌビディアＣＥＯ不倫相手の企業巡り＝報道 1:26 配信

2026年10月29日、ベセント米財務長官。REUTERS/Eric Lee（ロイター） ［１１日　ロイター］　 - ベセント米財務長官が、シンガポールを拠点とするクラウドコンピューティング企業メガスピードを国家安全保障上の懸念がある企業のリストに掲載しなかったとして、ラトニック米商務長官を問いただしたことが分かった。アクシオスが１１日、事情に詳しい複数の関係者の話として報じた。

メガスピードは、米半導体大手エヌビディアの顧客であり、同社のジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の不倫相手とされる中国人女性アリス・フアン氏が支配株主となっていたことがある。アリス・フアン氏は中国の情報機関の協力者だったと報じられており、メガスピードは米国の輸出規制対象となっているエヌビディアの先端半導体を中国企業が入手するのを手助けした疑いが持たれている。

FAST

MADRID, Nov 11 : Spain's data protection watchdog AEPD said on Wednesday that it had launched a probe into the alleged proliferation of child sexual abuse material on social media platform TikTok brought to light in an investigation by a local news website. However, the AEPD rejected the government's demand to temporarily block the app in the country, opting instead for measures targeting specific content. • The Spanish probe comes as big tech companies face growing scrutiny across Europe over harmful and illegal online content affecting minors • TikTok did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment

• Separately, Spain's attorney general ordered the cybercrimes prosecutor to investigate "any potential crimes related to the production and dissemination of child sexual abuse material and the corruption of minors that may have been committed" on TikTok • The government's demand to suspend access to the platform followed investigative reporting by Spanish online outlet Maldita.es, which documented 1,183 explicit posts • The AEPD said it would ask Maldita.es for the links identified in its exposé and request that TikTok provide information on measures taken to remove the reported content • After examining the information, the agency said it would take "concrete, proportionate and appropriate" measures such as blocking access to links and specific content involving unlawful treatment of minors' data • The AEPD said the lead privacy regulator for TikTok in Europe was Ireland's Data Protection Commission, which limited the Spanish watchdog's powers • It said, however, that it would share information with Irish authorities, other European regulators and the European Commission

Source: Reuters

item.title: ドイツ、拡大する財政赤字の抑制必要 経済専門家評議会が報告書
item.description: [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済専門家評議会は１１日に発表した年次報告書で、政府が国防費と年金給付への...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ、拡大する財政赤字の抑制必要　経済専門家評議会が報告書 0:52 配信

2026年11月11日、ドイツ・ベルリンで経済専門家評議会がドイツ経済に関する新たな見通しを発表。REUTERS/Lisi Niesner（ロイター） [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済専門家評議会は１１日に発表した年次報告書で、政府が国防費と年金給付への支出増加を抑制し、増加の一途をたどる財政赤字を食い止める必要があると警告した。

• 現在の予算予測ではカバーしていない２０４０年までに年間生産高の２．７─４．８％の財政赤字が発生すると予測。

• 評議会の提言には、補助金の全体的な削減も盛り込まれた。

• 報告書は、債務による軍事支出に関するルールは３１年から段階的に厳格化される必要があると付け加えた。

• また、輸出が増加する中、今年の経済成長率を１．３％、来年を１％とする、より楽観的な予測を示した。

• これは主要経済研究所の予測とおおむね一致しており、５月に発表された予測値（今年０．５％、２７年０．８％）から上方修正された。

item.title: イタリア全土6300校に爆破予告、学生ら避難 英・アイルランドでも
item.description:
Alvise Armellini Giuseppe Fonte
[ローマ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alvise Armellini　Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １１日 ロイター] - イタリア全土で１１日、約６３００校の学校が爆破予告のメールを受け取り、直ちに閉鎖され、学生らが相次いで避難する騒ぎとなった。

スコットランド、北アイルランド、アイルランドでも、多くの学校が国外から同様の脅迫メールを受け取ったが、いたずらと判断され、授業に支障は出なかったとしている。

欧州では最近、スーパーマーケットや血液バンク、航空交通、放送局などを標的とした一連の脅迫やサイバー攻撃が発生している。

ロイターがイタリアで入手したメールには「ミソギニスタン州の指導者、ミハイル・アンドロポフ」と署名されていた。同じ人物を名乗る差出人は、６日にアイルランドとブルガリアの報道機関に送られた爆破予告メールについても犯行を主張していた。

また、メールにはメローニ首相を標的にするとの脅迫も含まれていた。首相は、爆破予告に実質的な危険はなく、警察や他の公的機関が状況を監視していると述べた。

＜ロシアとイランは関与否定＞

欧州の一部の当局者は、ウクライナを支援する欧州諸国の日常生活を混乱させる一連の工作の背後にロシアがいる可能性があるとみている。

ロシアはこれを否定し、西側が中傷キャンペーンを行っていると非難している。

イランの関与も疑われている。フランスは、先に多数のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵設備を機能停止させたサイバー攻撃をイランが行ったと非難し、駐仏イラン大使を呼んで抗議した。イランはこれらの非難を「根拠がなく敵対的だ」として退けた。

イタリアのクロゼット国防相は、メディアに対し、１１日の脅迫は「恐怖を広め、不安を生み出す」ための明確な戦略の一環だと表明。「常に外国や敵対的な組織の仕業とは限らない。注目を集めたがる者や、こうした時期に乗じて都市や地域に恐怖をばらまこうと待ち構えている異常者もいる」と語った。

item.title: 米中外相が電話会談、王氏「意思疎通・協力強化を」＝新華社
item.description: [北京／ワシントン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京／ワシントン １１日 ロイター] - 中国の王毅外相は１１日、ルビオ米国務長官と「前向きで建設的な」電話会談を行った。中国の国営新華社が報じた。中国側は米政府との意思疎通と協力を強化する意向を表明した。

報道によると、王氏は米中関係が現在の安定基調に至るまでの道のりは容易ではなかったと指摘。「両大国がそれぞれの利益と共通の利益に基づいて下した合理的な選択だ」と述べた。

今回の会談は、中国の深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議を約１週間後に控えて行われた。同会議では、習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領の会談が見込まれている。

米国務省からは会談についての発表は直ちにはなかった。

習氏とトランプ氏は２０２６年に入って既に２回会談している。ルビオ氏は１０日、記者団に対し、トランプ氏と習氏、ロシアのプーチン大統領が参加する３者会談をＡＰＥＣの機会に合わせて開催するよう調整を進めていると語った。ルビオ氏は、トランプ氏がその会談の実現を望んでいるとした上で、「実現は可能だと考えている」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領は８日、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせ、中国の習近平国家主席、ロシアのプーチン大統領と会談し、イランでの戦争終結や非核化について協議することになるとの見通しを示した。

item.title: ロシア・ウクライナ協議、捕虜交換など一定の進展 領土問題では隔たり
item.description:
Roula Rouhana
[アブダビ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Roula Rouhana

[アブダビ １１日 ロイター] - アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の首都アブダビで行われたロシアとウクライナ、米国の協議は、２日間の日程を終え、捕虜交換などで一定の進展があった。ただ、仲介に当たった米国は、ロシアとウクライナの双方に信頼が欠如しており、領土などの問題で隔たりが残っていると述べた。

ロシアとウクライナにとって９カ月ぶりとなる今回の和平協議で、両国は大規模な捕虜交換で合意した。しかし、具体的な発表はほかにほとんどなかった。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏は、戦争終結に向けて、仲介者が双方の利益に訴えかけていると説明。和平への道筋を見いだせると確信していると述べた。

クシュナー氏は「現実として、今は双方の間に信頼がない。このような紛争の後ではそれも予想されることだ」と述べた上で、協議では領土問題にも触れたが、これらが解決に最も困難な問題になるとの見方を示した。

さらに「妥協点を見いだせる分野もあれば、さらに議論が必要な分野もある。だが、これは非常に良い一歩だったと思う」と語った。

ウクライナ和平協議でロシアの首席交渉担当者を務めるウラジーミル・メジンスキー氏は１１日、アブダビでの２日間の協議を経て、和平合意に近づいたとの見方を示した。

ロシア国営テレビの記者から和平合意に近づいたかと問われ、「そう思う」と回答。「ただ、現時点では、協議に関わる全ての当事者に大きく左右される。ウクライナや米国の姿勢、そして欧州が正気を取り戻すかどうかに大きくかかっている」と述べた。

メジンスキー氏はまた、ロシア国営タス通信に対し、ロシアの「全ての土地」はロシアに返還されると述べ、ロシア側の従来の要求を改めて示した。これは、ウクライナにドンバス全域の明け渡しを求めるプーチン氏の主張を指しているとみられる。ロシアは、いかなる和平合意の一環としても、ウクライナとの領土交換の可能性はないとの見解を示している。

インターファクス通信によると、同氏はさらに、ウクライナとの国境沿いに設けられたロシアの緩衝地帯はすでに相当な規模に達しており、今後も拡大し続けると付け加えた。

一方、ウクライナの交渉担当者ダビド・アラハミヤ氏は、ロシア代表団が「厳格な指示」を携えて臨み、協議は厳しいものだったとしつつ、年内の解決に向けて「良い勢い」が生まれたと述べた。詳細には言及しなかった。

ウクライナのブダノフ大統領府長官はテレグラムに「ウクライナの立場は変わらない。戦争を終わらせ、永続的な平和を保証し、ロシアによる侵略が再び起こらないようにする効果的な安全保障の枠組みを構築する必要がある」と投稿した。また、捕虜交換に関する協議は「重要な成果」をもたらしたと述べた。

タス通信は、ロシア軍のアレクサンドル・ゾリン中将の言葉を引用し、交渉で合意された大規模な捕虜交換が今後２─３週間以内に行われる可能性があると報じた。

アブダビには欧州当局者や北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の代表も訪れ、米国やウクライナの特使らと会談したが、ロシア代表団は面会を拒否した。ウクライナのアラハミヤ氏は、今後の和平協議は多国間で行い、欧州も交渉の場に加える必要があると述べた。

クシュナー氏とトランプ米政権のウィットコフ中東担当特使は１２日にモスクワを訪れてプーチン氏と会談し、協議を欧州のパートナーにも広げる問題を提起する。同氏は、欧州のパートナーも交渉の場に加わる必要があると述べた。クシュナー氏は、欧州の安全保障の枠組みが合意の基礎になり得るとしたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

クシュナー、ウィットコフ両氏は１２日のモスクワでの会談後、アイルランドを訪問中のウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と協議する予定。

LONDON, Nov 11 : AI chip startup Fractile was valued at $7 billion in its latest fundraising round, which included backing from the British government, a person involved in the deal said on Wednesday, making it one of Britain's most valuable technology startups. The London- and Bristol-based company is developing chips designed to improve AI inference, the process through which AI models generate responses. Fractile says its technology can deliver faster performance while cutting energy use and costs. The company raised $720 million in a Series C funding round led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint, it told Reuters. Other investors included Google's venture arm CapitalG, BlackRock, DST Global, Elad Gil, Balderton, SV Angel, Britain's Sovereign AI fund and the British Business Bank.

BRITAIN'S AI AMBITIONS The investment marks a major vote of confidence in Britain's efforts to build domestic AI infrastructure, rather than solely relying on overseas suppliers for the computing power that underpins the technology. It also highlights growing investor interest in companies developing the hardware behind AI, a market dominated by Nvidia and a handful of Asian semiconductor manufacturers. Britain has made becoming an AI superpower a key part of its economic strategy, seeking to build on strengths in AI research and chip design while retaining more of the jobs, investment and economic value generated by the technology. "For too long, Britain has produced some of the world's best scientific ideas, only to see too much of the technology, industry and wealth they create built elsewhere," AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said in a statement on the funding round. "We are determined to change that." Britain is home to chip designer Arm, whose technology is used in billions of devices worldwide, but its semiconductor manufacturing industry remains small compared with those in the US and Asia. Fractile plans to launch its first commercial chip next year. ($1 = 0.7492 pounds)

item.title: インドネシア副大統領が辞任、学歴巡る疑惑で 政情不安増幅も
item.description:
Ananda Teresia
[ジャカルタ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ananda Teresia

[ジャカルタ １１日 ロイター] - インドネシアのギブラン副大統領（３９）が辞任した。側近が１１日明らかにした。

ギブラン氏はジョコ前大統領の長男で、学歴に関する書類が選挙の要件を満たしていないとの最高裁判所判断が１０月に示されて以降、厳しい批判にさらされていた。同国でさらなる政情不安を招く恐れがある。

側近のブディ・アリエ・セティアディ氏はロイターに対し、ギブラン氏が１１日、プラボウォ大統領に辞表を提出したと述べた。

これとは別に、辞任の承認と後任の選定手続きを担う国会上院の関係者２人はロイターに対し、ギブラン氏が１２日朝に辞表を上院に提出すると語った。

ギブラン氏の事務所はコメントの要請にすぐには応じなかった。今回の問題は、ジョコウィの愛称で知られるウィドド氏とプラボウォ氏の対立が深まる中で表面化した。

LONDON, Nov 11 : Turkey needs to further strengthen its regulatory framework for crypto assets and stablecoins to address potential financial stability risks linked to the fast-growing sector, the G20's Financial Stability Board said on Wednesday. In a review of Turkey's implementation of international standards for crypto assets, the global financial watchdog said the country had made "meaningful progress" by putting much of the crypto market under regulatory oversight. But it said further action was needed to improve alignment with the FSB's global recommendations and address the risks of a largely retail investor-driven sector that saw nearly $200 billion worth of transactions last year, according to the review. It highlighted that cryptocurrencies and stablecoins have become increasingly important in Turkey for those seeking protection from years of sharp lira depreciation and high inflation.

The FSB recommended the establishment of dedicated regulations around stablecoins, which are typically pegged to the dollar and have been growing in popularity. "There remains no framework in place for the regulation of stablecoin issuers," the FSB said, describing it as "a core financial‑stability concern" given the strong FX‑linked channels and potential for "digital dollarisation".  SAFEGUARDS TO CURB CRYPTO, BROADER FINANCIAL SYSTEM LINKS The FSB's concerns add to a growing list of tasks for Turkey's authorities, who are scrambling to tighten regulations after a $20 billion investment fund scandal left millions of Turks out of pocket.Wednesday's crypto review noted the country had introduced safeguards aimed at limiting links between crypto assets and the broader financial system, including banning their use for domestic payments. But it urged authorities to also put in place a formal framework for monitoring financial stability risks, to collect and centralise more market data and improve cooperation with overseas regulators. "The borderless character of these markets means that no jurisdiction can address the associated risks through domestic action alone," the FSB said.

Source: Reuters

Nov 11 : Europe's largest energy grid operator E.ON is reviewing whether former nuclear plant sites in Germany could be converted into data centres, its finance chief said on Wednesday during a post-earnings presentation. A six-decade nuclear programme in Germany came to an end in 2023, leaving dozens of inactive sites across the country, after Berlin pledged to quit nuclear power following the 2011 Fukushima disaster in Japan. • "These former power plants can provide attractive industrial locations and depending on the site, we can use the existing infrastructure, particularly the large grid connection," CFO Nadia Jakobi said • E.ON is taking a "first step" with US chip designer Nvidia to establish the project's viability, she added • Jakobi said she was hopeful former sites would soon become available and that E.ON had become "world class" in nuclear demolition

item.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias
item.description: SAO PAULO, Nov 11 : Brazil's electoral authority fined Meta's Facebook 7.5 million reais ($1.34 million) for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during last month's presidential election runoff campaign, but said there was no evidence so far the company had deliberately acted to influence the outcome.

Brazilian right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro of the Liberal Party (PL) and leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva of the Workers’ Party (PT), who is seeking reelection, attend a televised debate ahead of the presidential election runoff in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, October 23, 2026. FAST

SAO PAULO, Nov 11 : Brazil's electoral authority fined Meta's Facebook 7.5 million reais ($1.34 million) for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during last month's presidential election runoff campaign, but said there was no evidence so far the company had deliberately acted to influence the outcome. In a unanimous decision, the country's top electoral court (TSE) ruled on Tuesday that Facebook had failed to adequately meet court demands related to allegations that its platform treated content from the rival campaigns of leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro differently. Lula's coalition filed a complaint ahead of the vote alleging restrictions on the distribution of its posts, the activity of purportedly inauthentic accounts, failures in identifying AI-generated content and asymmetries in the operation of Meta's tools. Meta told the court last month it had adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of the two campaigns.

"Meta complies with Brazilian electoral law and applies the same rules to all candidates and parties. We will continue to present the facts and defend ourselves against false allegations in the ongoing legal proceedings," Meta said in a statement on Wednesday. The court said Meta had provided some information and documents on the measures, but found that parts of its orders were either not complied with, were only partially fulfilled, or were carried out after deadlines had passed. "The records contain technical failures acknowledged by Facebook itself, but there are no elements allowing us to conclude, on a preliminary basis, that there was deliberate action to unbalance the election," Justice Marco Aurelio Bellizze wrote in his ruling. "That conclusion would require robust evidence, to be produced through the appropriate legal proceedings," he added. According to Bellizze, the fine reflected Meta's conduct in responding to the court orders as a whole, including delays, incomplete information and difficulties in verifying some of the data submitted. The amount corresponds to three daily fines of 500,000 reais between October 17 and 19, and six days of fines of 1 million reais per day between October 20 and 25, when Lula unexpectedly secured re-election over Bolsonaro after his team mobilized a huge social media campaign. Lula has long vowed to tighten rules on social media in the country. In his victory speech, he said: "We had to overcome foreign interference in the election, coming from outside through digital platforms that we will have to regulate." ($1 = 5.5832 reais)

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 11 : CoreWeave jumped 10 per cent on Wednesday, igniting a rally in battered AI cloud stocks, as its hefty spending yielded strong revenue growth and the company signaled a pullback from the borrowing binge that had set off alarms of an AI bubble. The earnings also lifted shares of key CoreWeave backer Nvidia by 5 per cent, after a bruising two-day slide driven by worries about CEO Jensen Huang's future at the company following his affair with a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. Shares of so-called "neoclouds" including Nebius and Iren rallied after facing weeks of turmoil on fears that their debt-fueled data center expansion could backfire if AI demand slows. The Democratic midterm sweep last week dealt another blow to the industry, with several winning candidates campaigning for tighter regulation and moratoriums on new data center construction, including in the crucial market of Texas.

CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator told Reuters on Tuesday that greater scrutiny could slow data center construction across the industry, but he did not expect it to significantly alter the company's expansion plans or drive up costs. The company also raised its annual revenue forecast and said it would not tap unsecured debt markets after a recent spike in borrowing costs and that cash flow from existing contracts would cover both current and future debt repayments. "CoreWeave delivered about the best quarter we could have asked for. Stats were good-to-great, funding concerns were addressed and the strategic moves make sense," Bernstein analysts led by Madison Rezaei said in a client note. But they warned that CoreWeave "will be among the first and hardest hit" when the crunch in AI computing capacity eases. The risks of mistiming AI investments became evident on Tuesday as SoftBank took a $3.7 billion writedown on non-refundable payments for equipment to power its US data centers. That pushed the Japanese tech investor to a second-quarter net loss of $7 billion, its first in nearly two years. For now, CoreWeave's results gave investors in AI infrastructure stocks reason to cheer, with Nebius, Iren, Oracle and Applied Digital climbing between 4.7 per cent and 11.8 per cent in premarket trading. All the stocks but Nebius have lost 32 per cent to 48 per cent this year as of Tuesday, while Nebius has surged 60 per cent. Together, the cloud companies, including CoreWeave, were set to gain more than $25 billion in market value on the day, while Nvidia alone stood to add about $210 billion, if gains hold. Nebius is due to report results before Thursday's opening bell.

Source: Reuters

ROME: Schools across Italy were evacuated on Wednesday (Nov 11) after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings, the latest in a series of threats and cyberattacks around Europe against supermarkets, blood banks, air traffic and broadcasters. Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland said many of their schools received a similar email threat from abroad but it was classed as a hoax and did not disrupt classes. In Italy, schools closed swiftly after the warnings, prompting many parents to drop what they were doing to collect children. "My daughter Dafne started crying because the kids did not understand what was happening, and she was still shaken when I picked her up," said Nensi Bego, parent of a child at the Mazzini middle school in Rome.

"This is so annoying. It's obvious it's just a hoax that disrupts lessons and disrupts everyone's day." A copy of the message seen by Reuters also included a threat to target Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. She said the bomb alerts posed no danger and that police and other public bodies were monitoring the situation. "All students have been taken to a safe area and remain under the supervision of teaching staff," one school in Rome informed parents through a messaging app. The email received in Italy was signed "Mikhail Andropov, leader of the Vilayat of Misoginistan," according to a copy of the message seen by Reuters. “The (school) emails are public. (Sending the bomb alert messages) was as easy as drinking a glass of water,” a national security source told Reuters. The same purported author claimed responsibility for email bomb threats sent on Friday to newsrooms in Ireland and Bulgaria. RUSSIA AND IRAN DENY ACCUSATIONS Some European officials suspect Russia may be behind a campaign of disruption to everyday life in European nations supporting Ukraine after Moscow's invasion. Russia denies that and accuses the West of a smear campaign. Iran is another suspect. France summoned Iran's ambassador on Tuesday after accusing Tehran of a cyberattack that disabled refrigerators in hundreds of supermarkets last week. Iran rejected those accusations as "baseless and hostile". Italian Defence Minister Guido Crosetto said Wednesday's threats were p art of a clear strategy "to spread fear and create anxiety," according to Adnkronos news agency. "It is not always the work of foreign countries or hostile entities. There are also attention-seekers and lunatics who, at a time like this, cannot wait to unleash terror in a city or a region," he added. Antonello Giannelli, head of the Italian School Principals Association, said the alerts were upsetting for students, families and school staff. "Even though today’s threats are clearly hoaxes, we cannot underestimate the consequences of incidents that alarm entire school communities and disrupt the normal conduct of educational activities," he said.

item.title: 中国人民銀、景気下支え強化へ 内需拡大と供給最適化図る
item.description: [北京 １１日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は１１日公表した第３・四半期の金融政策執行報告で、国内外の逆...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国人民銀、景気下支え強化へ　内需拡大と供給最適化図る 11/11 20:40 配信

北京の中国人民銀行本部、2022年撮影 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang（ロイター） [北京 １１日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は１１日公表した第３・四半期の金融政策執行報告で、国内外の逆風に対応し、カウンターシクリカルな政策調整を強化すると表明した。内需の拡大と供給の最適化を図り、年間の経済発展目標の達成を目指す。

・人民銀は、中国経済が強い供給と弱い需要のミスマッチ、構造的な不均衡、外部からの衝撃といった課題に直面していると指摘。対外環境は複雑さを増し、変動が激しくなっているとの認識を示した。

・安定した経済成長に向けて良好な金融環境を整えるため、適度に緩和的な金融政策を引き続き実施するとした。

・金融政策手段を適時に調整する方針も改めて示した。

・資金調達コスト全体を低水準に維持し、人民元相場を合理的で均衡の取れた水準で基本的に安定させるとした。

・報告によると、内需、科学技術革新、インフラ事業などの重点分野への金融支援を強化する。

・政策手段の拡充を図り、株式・債券・外国為替市場の安定的な運営を確保する方針も表明した。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：人民元／円相場の記録的高騰に見る円の構造的脆弱性＝植野大作氏 焦点：人民元国際化に低金利の追い風、起債や融資が拡大 コラム：人民元高が堅調な中国輸出の妨げとならない理由 11/11(水) 20:43 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: イラン、濃縮核物質の国外搬出認めず＝安保トップ
item.description: [ドバイ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ １１日 ロイター] - イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。

レバノンの親イラン系テレビ局アルマヤディーンに述べた。「米国が再び攻撃すれば、遠方の米軍基地も攻撃対象となる」と語った。

イランの高官２人は５月、兵器級に近い濃縮ウランを国外に搬出しないよう最高指導者が指示したと明らかにしている。

米国は両国間の戦争終結を目指すイランとの交渉では、初期段階から核問題を議題に含める必要があるとしている。レザイ氏は、イランと米国の間で現在、交渉は行われていないと述べている。

FAST

BRUSSELS, Nov 11 : Companies resorting to unfair digital trade practices to push people to buy more or target children with personalised advertising risk fines of as much as 6 per cent of their annual global turnover under a new European Commission draft law. "Our consumer protection rules will help ensure that businesses compete on the merits of their products and services, not on their ability to exploit consumers or their ability to evade the rules," said EU justice chief Michael McGrath. "We are not making it harder to do business, we are making it harder to do business unfairly," McGrath told a press conference on Wednesday. The proposed Digital Fairness Act (DFA) aims to give consumers more rights but has been criticised by some businesses because of overlaps with existing laws and a proposed plan to keep children safe from online dangers.

The DFA, part of a crackdown requiring Big Tech and online platforms to do more to police their platforms, would need to be agreed with European Union countries and the European Parliament in the coming months before it can become law. The proposed law wants to ban dark patterns, which encourage people to spend more than they otherwise might, and gambling features such as pay-to-win and pay-to-progress that encourage overspending, especially among children. It would require companies to give users the option to turn off addictive designs of digital products and influencers to be more transparent about commercial content. It also takes aim at pricing practices such as dynamic pricing where ticket prices fluctuate based on real-time demand, which has triggered criticism from consumers, and subscription traps, which the Commission said cost consumers billions of euros yearly. A plan to revise separate legislation called the Consumer Protection Cooperation Regulation would empower the Commission to investigate big cases in several EU countries and also hand out fines up to 6 per cent of a company's global annual revenue. Lobbying group BusinessEurope criticised the draft law. "The Digital Fairness Act should make the existing framework more coherent, predictable and effective," BusinessEurope Director General Markus J. Beyrer said. "Instead, it risks introducing unnecessary obligations and overlapping requirements that undermine legal certainty and run counter to the EU’s simplification agenda," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Nov 11 : An elite North Korean hacking group’s $6.3 billion theft from Binance is renewing scrutiny of a longstanding weakness in the cryptocurrency industry: hackers may need to compromise only one employee to get inside, while inconsistent security practices can allow them to turn that foothold into a massive th

Analysis:Binance hack reveals crypto's uphill battle against hackers

FILE PHOTO: Binance logo is seen in this illustration taken March 31, 2023. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

11 Nov 2026 07:06PM (Updated: 12 Nov 2026 12:55AM)

FAST

Nov 11 : An elite North Korean hacking group’s $6.3 billion theft from Binance is renewing scrutiny of a longstanding weakness in the cryptocurrency industry: hackers may need to compromise only one employee to get inside, while inconsistent security practices can allow them to turn that foothold into a massive theft. The October 29 heist, described by experts as the largest cryptocurrency theft ever, unfolded in a matter of minutes after months of planning and preparation, according to Binance’s initial investigation. Cybersecurity experts said the attack raises questions not only about how exchanges defend employees against sophisticated social engineering, but also about whether they have adequate internal controls to limit what an attacker can do once an employee’s computer or credentials are compromised. Social engineering is a well-understood threat in the industry, said Jonathan Alexander, chief technology officer of S&P Global’s OpenZeppelin, a blockchain security provider. The bigger question, he said, is why exchanges do not have stronger internal safeguards and circuit breakers to prevent an attacker who breaches an engineer’s computer — like what happened at Binance — from escalating access and moving assets.

Varying cybersecurity practices across the industry compound the problem, Alexander said, along with a longstanding aversion among some cryptocurrency advocates to controls they view as inconsistent with blockchain’s decentralized ethos that sometimes views things such as limits on transaction amounts and automatic reviews of patterns of spending as infringing on inherent privacy rights. "I think that falsely, that has led some people to think that things like circuit breakers, things like more controls on the accounts, would be unacceptable or would be absolutely in conflict with that need to avoid censorship," Alexander said. "In my view, you can have security controls and have protections against that." The Binance attack is the latest in a string of major cryptocurrency hacks that have resulted in more than $22.3 billion in stolen funds since 2021, according to blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis. The scale of the losses has intensified debate over whether exchanges need more consistent standards governing access, transaction controls and other defenses. “I do expect we’ll see more clarity and standardization in the kind of cybersecurity expectations and, hopefully, requirements for investor protection and trust," Alexander said. “These things show why it has to change." HIGHLY VISIBLE, ATTRACTIVE TARGETS Cryptocurrency exchanges present unusually attractive targets because hackers can identify wallets holding enormous sums of readily transferable digital assets and, in some cases, the employees with access to the systems controlling them. That has made engineers and IT workers prime targets for elaborate social-engineering operations. Alex Pruden, CEO of blockchain and digital-asset security firm Project Eleven, said defenders face a fundamental disadvantage against attackers who need to succeed only once. “This is an extremely hard problem,” Pruden said. “The best practices in cybersecurity that we've had up to this point are just simply not up to the task of the world that we live in in terms of what the threat is.” Cybersecurity workers in the industry, he added, “live in a world of constant warfare. We are under constant attack.” Pruden expects the Binance theft to spur greater investment in cybersecurity, including safeguards around internal AI tools and agents that could themselves expand an attacker’s capabilities if compromised. "We're at the beginning of the beginning of that story, but I just think like the Binance hack showed, those tools can be turned against you very, very quickly and they can be very hard to undo the damage once it's done." Cryptocurrency exchanges have already begun moving to bolster defenses and increase information sharing following the Binance hack, Reuters reported October 30. PATCHWORK OVERSIGHT, UNEVEN DEFENSES The uneven security practices identified by experts are mirrored by a fragmented US regulatory system. Unlike banks, US cryptocurrency exchanges do not operate under a single federal cybersecurity regime. Instead, requirements vary depending on where companies operate and which state licenses they hold. New York imposes some of the industry's toughest requirements. The state's Department of Financial Services requires licensed companies to maintain cybersecurity programs, use multi-factor authentication and designate a chief information security officer. Elsewhere, crypto companies may be subject primarily to state money-transmitter rules. Those regimes generally require companies to provide regulators with information about their cybersecurity programs and undergo examinations, but often do not prescribe particular technical controls, such as encryption standards.   Many exchanges do not operate in the US and are not subject to those state oversight regimes, although they may operate under separate requirements wherever they do business. Banks, by contrast, are subject to federal requirements covering areas including risk assessments, monitoring and incident response, while the largest institutions undergo continuing examinations by dedicated supervisors.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ドイツ軍、中国製無人機の使用中止へ 安保上の懸念で
item.description: [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - 独国防省の報道官は１１日、ドイツ軍が中国製無人機（ドローン）の使用を取りやめると明らかにした。西側諸国の軍では、中国製ドローンが安全保障上のリスクとなり、機密情報が中国に送られる恐れがあるとの懸念が強まっている。

報道官によると、中国製ドローンはこれまで、費用対効果の高い選択肢として射撃などの訓練用に使用が認められていた。今後は欧州製品に置き換える。

報道官は電子メールの声明で「独連邦軍の自立性と技術主権を強化するため、中国製モデルは今後使用しない」と述べた。特定の国のシステムの使用を一律に禁止しているわけではないとし、今回の決定は軍の安全やＩＴとデータのセキュリティーを守るための個別のリスク評価に基づくと説明した。

また特定の国やメーカーの車両を一律に禁止しているわけではないと述べた。ただ最近の車両に搭載されたセンサーは潜在的な安全保障上のリスクと見なされており、必要に応じて機密性の高い軍事施設への立ち入りを制限することがあるとした。

item.title: 戦争・貿易紛争より温暖化対策を、各国首脳訴え 3日目のＣＯＰ３１
item.description:
Tuvan Gumrukcu Valerie Volcovici
[アンタルヤ （トルコ） １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Valerie Volcovici

[アンタルヤ （トルコ）　１１日 ロイター] - ブラジルとトルコの首脳は１１日、トルコで開かれている第３１回国連気候変動枠組み条約締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）で演説し、戦争や貿易紛争で地球温暖化対策から世界の関心がそれることがあってはならないと訴えた。

会議は３日目を迎え、各国首脳による演説が始まった。気候変動対策の国際的な取り組みを前進させる新たな合意に向け、交渉の道筋を付ける狙いがある。

２０２５年の会議を主催したブラジルのルラ大統領は「１年前、世界はＣＯＰ３０を終えて活力を得た。しかし２６年初めにはこの勢いが衰えた。世界の指導者の演説や文書から気候変動が消えた」と指摘。「われわれは将来世代の生存よりも、武器や関税について多く語るようになった。地球が覇権争いに翻弄されてはならない」と表明した。

トルコのエルドアン大統領も同様の認識を示し、「戦争、危機、移民、飢餓、貧困によって、国際的な連帯の必要性は日々高まっている」と語った。

ＣＯＰ３１では約２００カ国の交渉担当者が、世界のエネルギー利用に占める電力の割合を高めるというトルコの提案への合意と、停滞している化石燃料からの脱却に向けた取り組みの再活性化を目指している。

国連のグテレス事務総長も１１日に演説、国際社会の気候変動への対応が遅れたことで世界は破滅への道を歩んでいると警告し、将来世代のために地球を守るべく、各国政府は一段と力を尽くさなければならないと訴えた。

排出量と世界の気温の上昇、気候変動に伴う災害の深刻化を挙げ、「気候危機の進行にわれわれの対応が追い付いていないという厳しい現実がある。これは相互確証破壊への道だ」と述べた。「しかし科学がわれわれに求めているのは降伏ではない。一段と力を尽くして闘うことだ」と強調した。

グテレス氏は各国にクリーンエネルギーへの移行を加速するよう求め、世界の化石燃料依存は気候だけでなく、経済にも打撃を与えていると述べた。イラン戦争開始以降、石油価格が急騰していることを念頭に置いた発言とみられる。

「世界の人々の４分の３は化石燃料の輸入国に暮らしている。自ら引き起こしたわけでも、制御できるわけでもない価格ショックに翻弄されている」と指摘した。「最近の紛争はこれが慢性的な不安定と生活費の危機的な高騰を招くことをはっきり示している」と述べた。

１１日は欧州連合（ＥＵ）のフォンデアライエン欧州委員長、中国の韓正国家副主席、マーシャル諸島のヒルダ・ハイネ大統領らが演説する予定だ。

米国は２年連続で会議への参加を見送った。フランス、ドイツ、日本、イタリア、カナダなども今年は首脳を派遣していない。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国上昇、香港は下落
item.description: ［１１日 ロイター］ - 中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国上昇、香港は下落 11/11 19:37 配信

［１１日　ロイター］ - 中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場安定化策を市場は注視している。

上海総合指数は序盤の下げから切り返し０．５％高で引けた。ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．４％上昇。

ハイテク株が上げを主導。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は３．１％、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は２．８％それぞれ上昇した。

通信関連も上昇率の大きい業種の一つとなり、ＣＳＩ５Ｇ通信指数は６．７％高。光通信モジュールメーカーの中際旭創は１５％超急伸した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が１％安の２万４３１５．９２、ハンセンテック指数が１．４％安となった。

アジア域内の株式市場は、利上げ観測や原油市場動向にらみで動きづらく、狭いレンジでの取引となった。米国の消費者物価上昇率が予想を上回ったことや、政策当局者のタカ派姿勢を受け、利上げペースが加速するとの見方が強まった。

南華先物のアナリストはリポートで、これに伴う世界的な債券利回りの上昇とドル高が、中国Ａ株のバリュエーションを圧迫したと指摘。「足元の相場回復は主に、国内の市場支援策と海外の不確実性の一時的な緩和に支えられてきた。ただ、いずれの要因も効果の強さと持続性は限られるようだ。市場心理はやや改善したものの、投資家は総じて慎重姿勢を維持しており、株価指数は当面レンジ内で推移すると予想される」と述べた。

一方、原油価格は前営業日に２カ月ぶりの安値に下落した後、１１日は上昇した。イラン戦争の緊張緩和への期待と、ホルムズ海峡での船舶攻撃継続への懸念の間で市場は揺れ動いた。

item.description: BERLIN, Nov 11 : German defence technology company Helsing on Wednesday launched software designed to help militaries make sense of the flood of battlefield information generated by modern warfare, entering a market led by Palantir.Called Clarity, the software is designed to sift through information from dron
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Business

Helsing enters market for battlefield software built on combat data

FILE PHOTO: A delegate walks past a display showing an autonomous uncrewed combat aerial vehicle by Helsing at the Berlin Security Conference, a congress on European Security and Defence in Berlin, Germany, November 3, 2026. REUTERS/Annegret Hilse/File Photo

11 Nov 2026 06:31PM (Updated: 11 Nov 2026 06:52PM)

FAST

BERLIN, Nov 11 : German defence technology company Helsing on Wednesday launched software designed to help militaries make sense of the flood of battlefield information generated by modern warfare, entering a market led by Palantir. Called Clarity, the software is designed to sift through information from drones, satellites, military reports and open-source intelligence, helping users identify military assets and determine how they should be engaged, Helsing said. Human operators remain responsible for approving any strike. The launch comes as militaries absorb lessons from Ukraine, where drones have transformed the amount of information available to commanders. The flood of data can overwhelm staff, increasing the risk of missed targets, delayed responses and misallocated resources if information is not processed quickly enough.

Ukraine has built systems such as DELTA to collect and distribute data, while Palantir's Maven helps military users analyse it. European governments increasingly want greater control over military software and the data behind it, while reducing their dependence on individual suppliers. But the most established systems have a head start. Palantir's Maven sits inside Pentagon and NATO workflows and has been refined through years of operational use. Helsing, which has supplied drones and other systems to Ukraine, is among a small group of European defence technology firms able to argue it has gained access to operational experience from the conflict.  The company said Clarity was built around hundreds of specialised agents trained on military data and that it could identify military positions, cross-check information from multiple sources, establish confidence levels and recommend responses while showing users the evidence underpinning its conclusions. "We are entering an era where success on the battlefield will depend on how effectively armed forces can transform information into action," Helsing co-CEO Gundbert Scherf said.  "It is therefore important to connect what is seen to what is struck." Helsing did not disclose whether Clarity was already being used by military customers or when it expected it to enter service.  Germany's armed forces have previously said they aim to begin introducing AI-enabled systems from next year.

(Editing by Milla Nissi-Prussak)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair
item.description: Nvidia customer Megaspeed has made global news with its former executive Alice Huang accused of spying for Beijing, but CNA’s checks found it has limited operational presence in Singapore.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair

Nvidia customer Megaspeed has made global news with its former executive Alice Huang accused of spying for Beijing, but CNA’s checks found it has limited operational presence in Singapore.

Jensen Huang, president and CEO of Nvidia. (File photo: AP/Jeffrey McWhorter)

11 Nov 2026 06:17PM (Updated: 11 Nov 2026 07:37PM)

Bookmark

Bookmark
